purpose: Replay the most informative channel-saturation candidates with eight lens-geometry starts, including two incomplete-root candidates whose two-start scores would otherwise look unusually favorable.
claim_boundary: Universal gravity constants are copied unchanged from the channel-saturation bridge fit.
No gravity constant is fitted to raw lensing.
Only pseudo-elliptical geometry, shear, center, and source positions are fitted to raw training images.
Candidates with missing held-out roots are retained as failures even when the RMS over surviving roots is small.
The same four raw systems and within-family held-out images are used.
This checks numerical robustness; it does not remove the spherical-baryon, density-interpolation, or zero-slip approximations.
